title: Indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase (IDO) Activity in Patients With Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL)
brief_summary: The Activity of Indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase in patients with Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) is studied.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with CLL and lymphocyte count \> 10 x 109/l

Exclusion Criteria:

* Acute infection
